tests.name: Example
tests.setup:
c = LRUCache(2)
out = []
c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2)
out.append(c.get(1))
c.put(3, 3)
out.append(c.get(2))
c.put(4, 4)
out += [c.get(1), c.get(3), c.get(4)]

tests.name: Capacity 1
tests.setup:
c = LRUCache(1)
c.put(1, 10)
out = [c.get(1)]
c.put(2, 20)
out += [c.get(1), c.get(2)]

tests.name: Updating a key counts as using it
tests.setup:
c = LRUCache(2)
c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2); c.put(1, 100); c.put(3, 3)
out = [c.get(1), c.get(2), c.get(3)]
tests.hint: put on an existing key updates its value AND makes it the most recently used.

tests.name: get counts as using a key
tests.setup:
c = LRUCache(3)
for k in (1, 2, 3):
    c.put(k, k * 10)
c.get(1)
c.put(4, 40)
out = [c.get(1), c.get(2), c.get(3), c.get(4)]

tests.name: Random operations
200 000 calls, capacity 20 000
tests.hint: Moving a key to the front must be O(1). list.remove is O(N). Use a linked list of nodes plus a dict.
